name: idle-compact
description: Compacts the conversation after a stretch of idle minutes, before the prompt cache expires, so the next prompt does not pay to rebuild it

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Minutes after the last response with no new prompt before compacting. Keep it under your prompt cache's lifetime: 55 (the default) assumes a 1-hour cache; use 4 for a 5-minute one.

minContextPercent.title: Minimum context percent
minContextPercent.description: Compact only when the context window is at least this full (0-100); a small context is cheap to rebuild.
